book.name: Matyu
book.title: Matyu Matyu Re Basrasem Tuma Yenbo.

content: Tatame Remne Okke Tirmunbem Tame, Jon, re sam.
Er yabel Galili nowselri keryen yen, Herot, re Jisas reri nenbemkap metem.
Re reri yaku nen tame remne op wem. Er tame re tatame remne okke tirmunbem. Reri sig Jon. Kiyi an rene wak regem, re selek sene wayen sin kitimena poten re bukre wos ek nenbo. Op wem.
Jon reri sam tuma gwopkap. Kiyi Herot eter re Jon rene keikeren kepke bogen ake yaperke wen wurem. Bupo bo. Reri mase, Filip reri ta, Herodias etetri kwobo.
Kiyi Jon re Herot rene op webem. Ne neri mase reri ta panem, et yaperwai.
Op webem, Herot re pap yoken Jon rene pen sate wem. Nugwape tatame rem webem. Jon re God Reri Tuma wesowbo tame, re tame yenbo. Op webem. Herot re remri tuma metem, re rene pen sate akem.
Yabel wuri rane tame rem yan Herot eterkene wurem, rem Herot rene nawo te wurem yabel habobem, rem awos nenem. Herodias teri yenten yen te remri borke teten yage taibemke, Herot re okbopsubu tem.
Re tene op wem. Nem nene okbop tebo. Opkap ne anne be wos nene newote wete, an nene newote. An be yikokobo. An sekenewai webo. An nene newote tetane.

Op wemke, yen te teri nawo tene yin tuma wemeten op wem. Re anne wos newote weye. An berke wemette? Nawo te tene wemke, te sene wuram, te Herot rene nawo teri wem tuma rene op wem. Tatame remne Okke Tirmunbo Tame, Jon, ne rene wak regte, reri tare kawoke yewote, an ek potte.

Op wemke, Herot re pap yaper tem. Re Jon rene wak regte muwem, re habolaweyem. Re op habom. Nugwape tatame rem arenkene awos abo, rem ari tene weye tuma metye. An tene kap yikokote. Op habom, re op wem. Teri weye wos kem etop nente.
Op wem, re yaku nen tame werasen ake yaperke yin rem Jon reri wak regem.
Rem reri tare sen yan kawoke yewon et muyensi yen ta tene newom. Yen te poten sen yin nawot tene peteram.
Op temke, Jon reri anepoi tame rem yan reri kupa poten pertayen rem sene yin Jisas rene wesowem.
Jisas re ok yen ok tame (5,000) remne awos newon am.
Jisas re er tuma metemke, re er kwom mesegenen pere poten agerbo emik yim. Re wiysage tamekene bo emik yim. Tatame rem etop metem, rem remri ake mesegenen rene selke lasyim.
Yuri Jisas re yin gayen re nugwape tatame remne lam. Re remne pap tem, re remri sikanuma nenbem tatame remne heyarem.
Perpe reri anepoi tame rem yan rene op wem. Yabel warbo. Gwor emi et tamekene bo, tatame rem awos mak potte? Ne remne weraste, rem kwomke yin awos tupate.
Jisas re sein op wem. Rem kap yite. Kerem, kem remne awos newon ate.
Rem rene op wem. Nem awos nugwape bo. Geil letrane, omyen sauk pesketwou tetane.
Re remne op wem. Ne anne sen yate.

Re tatame remne op wem. Kem selke site. Re geil letrane, omyen sauk pes poten re le nelke niruw lan re God rene wese an mesegenem, re geil belokteyewon omyen pekayewom. Re reri anepoi tame remne newom, rem poten tatame remne newopiti pete yam, rem am.
Aboyei an seketemke, awos tep tem, rem poten eip letpeis tewo pes kerem etop yewon pulawen sim.
Siteren awos am tame etemwou rem karem, rem ok yen ok tame (5,000). Yenta remne rem be karem.
Jisas re wame ok luwke yim.
Jisas re anepoi tame remne op wem. Kem perek waren peik kelaruwke kiyi temnan yibet. Re tatame remne remri akwulke sene werasen yim.
Re wiysage kwowke yawum, re Apiy God rekene tuma namrete yawum. Yabel warbem, re etek wiysage temenem.
Tektemke, pere yen wuri, anepoi tame rem etek warmenem, rem peik mei borke temenemke, marye ek yam, ok burow pere tare yokwok tegilmubem.
Sene ei berate nenbemke, Jisas re ok luwke yin reri anepoi tame remne bowgte yibem.
Rem etop lam, rem kenakem aken taye piten op wem. Er peikri arkwu.
Jisas re remne op wem. Kem mane akte. Gwor aren. Kem kap akte.
Pita re rene sein op wem. Haneyen, neren sekene temente, ne anne wetek, an ok luwke nene lasyate.
Jisas re op wem. Ne opu ya. Pita re pere mesegenen re ok luwke Jisas rene lasyim.
Sene re marye lan akem. Re ok an abubem, re agetage Jisas rene op tem. Haneyen, ne anne kwobo lan nenewayete.
Agetage Jisas re rene let tayemke, rene keikeren rene op wem. Ne anne omuteke be haboye. Ne beberke wuribai pes ten me akye?
Op wemke, rep perek yin waremke, marye re ek tebeyem.
Perek temenem tame rem reri kitimena op lam, rem rene lom yokwon rene op wem. Sekenewai. Ne Keryen Yen God Eterri Yen.
Jisas re sikanuma tame remne Genesaret kwomke heyarem.
Rem wame kwuren kelaruwke yin Genesaret kwomke gayem.
Er kwomri tatame rem rene lam, rem op wem. Et Jisas. Op wemke, rem mekni kwomri tatame remne tuma weptimke, rem remri sikanuma nenmenem tatame remne panen yam.
Sikanuma nentene tatame rem rene op wemetem. Nem neri wetene tame oub tumakupak kerete, nem kwuye mette. Op wem, tatame rem reri wumenem tame oub tumakupak kerem, rem aboyei heyar kwuye metem.
